evidence: The manifest diff from base accf641 adds only REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS, and MainActivity opens the system request dialog via the Settings request action with a settings-screen fallback, so the exemption is user-granted only; SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, the notification listener service declaration and the location permissions are untouched by the merge.

Saved-location export writes solely through the CreateDocument contract to a user-chosen URI and import reads solely an OpenDocument user-picked URI, importJson leaves stored data untouched on parse failure and never deletes local-only entries, and the staged merge diff adds no file or network writes while app build script changes only versionCode and versionName.

Build evidence shows a successful compile of the merged tree, the shell keeps instance, pasteOnly, pasteAndSend and hasTextInput with byte-identical package routing and event-type handling, the two base functions absent by name were unused or empty no-ops, and the new packages depend only downward on eval, model, parser and a11y.

findings.claim: The migration to the shared evaluator replaces the base null guard on km with a 999.0 unknown-km sentinel, so condition 3 now passes when the km text cannot be parsed and the km threshold is set to 5.0 or higher. At base accf641 this path required a non-null km before condition 3 could fire, so the merge widens when the listener writes the reply to the clipboard and launches the forward activity with auto-send enabled.
proof_refs: Base accf641 NotificationInterceptorService lines 158 to 160 require kmRecogida not null for condition 3, while merged line 162 substitutes the 999.0 sentinel when the km pattern is missing.

AutoAcceptEvaluator line 66 accepts condition 3 whenever the km mode is enabled and the threshold is at least 5.0, without any knowledge of whether km was actually known, and the threshold is a free-text numeric field set in SettingsScreen line 464.
NotificationInterceptorService lines 169 onward copy the reply to the clipboard and start WhatsAppForwardActivity with the auto-send extra set true as soon as meetsConditions is true.

findings.location: app/src/main/java/com/example/projectacc/MyAccessibilityService.kt:25 and its imports at lines 7 to 15
findings.claim: The collaborator split leaves a bidirectional package dependency: the shell imports picap, whatsapp and a11y classes while those files import root symbols such as the SERVICE_TAG constant declared inside the shell file, OrderStateManager and FloatingPopupManager. There is no cycle among the new packages themselves, but the back edges to the root package weaken the module boundary the refactor is meant to establish.
proof_refs: MyAccessibilityService.kt line 25 declares SERVICE_TAG, which PicapOfferProcessor.kt line 9 and other new files import, while shell lines 7 to 15 import the new picap, whatsapp and a11y classes in return.
eval, model, parser and a11y import neither picap nor whatsapp, so the leaf packages remain acyclic and only reach pre-existing root code.
